description: TypeScript Node service / daemon. Fastify HTTP + better-sqlite3 / sqlite-vec storage, `tsc` build, Vitest tests, JSON-schema (ajv) wire contracts, OS-service deployment (schtasks / systemd / launchd). Fits astramemory-local-style local-first memory daemons and standalone Node services.
productDescription: Override productName and productDescription in .claude/loop.json after install.
stackDescription:
- TypeScript source (`src/**/*.ts`) compiled via `tsc -p .` to `dist/` (gitignored build output)
- Node 20+ ESM runtime (`"type": "module"`)
- Fastify HTTP daemon + CLI (`bin`); pino structured logging
- better-sqlite3 (multiple-ciphers) + sqlite-vec for local-first encrypted vector storage
- Vitest for tests (`bun run test` → `vitest run`)
- JSON-schema wire contracts under `contracts/` validated by ajv (`node contracts/validate.mjs`)
- OS-service deployment: schtasks (Windows) / systemd (Linux) / launchd (macOS) via the install wizard
- Override the second `test` stage to `null` in `.claude/loop.json` if the repo has no contracts/validate.mjs
